UPDATE outbox SET
           attempts = attempts + 1,
           last_error = left($2, 500),
           next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => least(power(2, attempts + 1), 3600)),
           failed_at = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= $3 THEN now() END,
           payload = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= $3 THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE payload END
         WHERE id = $1
